_README: Input for: uv run python scripts/dedup_seed_bank.py --manifest <this file> [--from-db]
Unknown top-level keys (like this one) are ignored by load_manifest().
root: index the chain.toml seed as the bank root. Keep true unless it is already indexed.
kings: romans on the <king_namespace>/<king_prefix>-<ROMAN> HF mirror. A bare string pins
to the repo's current head at run time; the object form takes an explicit 40-hex revision
plus the hotkey/coldkey that owns it (needed for OWN-COPY to work on that miner later).
models: any other repo, as {repo, revision} or a huggingface.co URL. The entry below shows the explicit-revision form; leave revision "" to pin to head like the kings above.
Order is root -> --from-db accepted submissions (oldest block first) -> kings -> models,
and each model is judged by the LIVE gate against whatever is already banked, so seed in
chronological order or a later king can read as a copy of one it actually preceded.
Every entry costs a ~67 GiB download that is deleted after indexing (--keep to retain).
